confidence_notes: Restaurant anchors come from crowd-sourced or small-sample sources (Expatistan, combien-coute.net, a less established guide) and are rough. The beer, wine and cocktail anchors are inferred: beer from one Florianópolis pub figure, cocktail from Rio and São Paulo downtown averages, and wine from its relation to beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not from inspected listings, and reflect July winter low season. The BRL-to-USD conversion assumes about 5.4 BRL per USD, implied by a single Big Mac price pair; it is not a verified current rate. The FX observation is the RBA figure for 15 October 2026 as reported in search results, not checked against the RBA page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mid-sized Brazilian coastal tourist city. Expatistan rates Florianópolis at about the same cost level as Brasília. Cappuccino is anchored on the Florianópolis expat-area figure and the São Paulo and Brasília averages. Cocktail is anchored on Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo downtown club averages. Beer and wine are priced relative to the local beer figure.
